title: The Gift of Sacrifice
text:
Many short stories are written to be read in a single sitting. Because they are brief, writers must choose every word carefully. A good short story often focuses on one character and one moment of change.

In the story 'The Gift of the Magi' by O. Henry, a young couple sacrifices their most valued possessions to buy presents for each other. The ending is ironic, yet it reveals the depth of their love. Readers often remember such endings long after the final line.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, how long are many short stories designed to be read?
What do the characters in 'The Gift of the Magi' do?
options: They move to a new city
They sacrifice their most valued possessions

questions.text: What can be inferred about the writer's view of short stories?
options: They are easier to write than novels

questions.text: Why might readers remember the ending of 'The Gift of the Magi'?
options: It has a happy ending with money
It is the longest part of the story
It shows love despite an ironic outcome

vocabulary.definition: lasting or covering only a short time or length
gives up something valuable for the sake of something else
having an outcome that is the opposite of what was expected

paragraph_translations: Багато коротких оповідань написано так, щоб їх можна було прочитати за один раз. Оскільки вони короткі, письменники мають ретельно обирати кожне слово. Добре коротке оповідання часто зосереджується на одному персонажі та одному моменті змін.

У оповіданні О. Генрі «Дар волхвів» молода пара жертвує своїми найціннішими речами, щоб купити подарунки одне одному. Кінцівка іронічна, але вона показує глибину їхнього кохання. Читачі часто пам'ятають такі кінцівки ще довго після останнього рядка.
